# DEV Community

> > A community of software developers sharing knowledge through articles, tutorials, and discussions on web development, open-source, and programming.

DEV Community is built on Forem, an open-source platform, and partnered with Major League Hacking (MLH). The community is led by Ben Halpern, Jess Lee, and Peter Frank, fostering collaboration among developers across topics like JavaScript, HTML5, game development, terminal tools, and API design.

## Key Topics

- DEV Community
- Forem platform
- Open-source development
- JavaScript
- HTML5
- Web development
- Game development
- REST API
- Terminal tools
- Linux/Ubuntu
- Community-driven learning
- Developer tutorials
- Code examples
- Beginner-friendly content

## About DEV Community

- [About DEV - DEV Community](https://dev.to/about): About DEV Community, Forem platform, and partnership with MLH

## Web Development Tutorials

- [Handling HTTP Status Codes in a REST API (200 OK vs. 201 Created) - DEV Community](https://dev.to/msnmongare/handling-http-status-codes-in-a-rest-api-200-ok-vs-201-created-28d): Tutorial on REST API HTTP status codes: 200 OK vs 201 Created usage
- [Java Script Game Codes: 10+ The Best javascript games code - DEV Community](https://dev.to/gscode/10-best-of-javascript-games-3mjj): Collection of 10+ JavaScript game code examples using HTML5, CSS, jQuery

## Terminal & System Administration

- [Kitty Terminal Basics + Cheatsheet - DEV Community](https://dev.to/otamm/kitty-terminal-basics-cheatsheet-1f0o): Kitty terminal emulator reference guide with shortcuts and configuration
- [Top 10 Termux Commands Every Beginner Should Know - DEV Community](https://dev.to/terminaltools/top-10-termux-commands-every-beginner-should-know-ooo): Beginner guide to essential Termux commands for Android Linux terminal
- [Rufus Bootable USB to install Ubuntu 22.04 LTS - DEV Community](https://dev.to/pinky057/rufus-bootable-usb-to-install-ubuntu-2204-lts-g7c): Step-by-step tutorial for creating Ubuntu 22.04 LTS bootable USB with Rufus
